name: Volumetric Depth Image (VDI) Rendering
definition: A rendering method for Volumetric Depth Images (VDIs) that decouples expensive volume rendering from interactive viewpoint changes by compositing pre-computed segments (supersegments) stored in the VDI, rather than integrating the volume rendering integral directly.
summary: Volumetric Depth Image rendering decouples volume integration from viewpoint changes by compositing pre-computed supersegments, achieving high frame rates via geometric intersection tests instead of per-pixel sample accumulation.
